title: Application to Visa Process Steps for Austria
notice: Austria visa appointments must be attended at the Austrian Embassy in New Delhi, India. Plan for India travel well in advance.

processSteps.label: Certificate Legalization (Apostille via MOFA) : 60,000 BDT
bullets: If you hold an A1 German certificate or IELTS 6.5+, legalization cost reduces to ~50,000 BDT
Apostille must be done BEFORE submitting university application

processSteps.label: University Application : Free for most public universities; private 25–100 EUR/application
Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Public universities in Austria charge no tuition for most programs (reciprocity countries)
Non-EU students may pay ~€726–1,500/semester continuation fee

processSteps.label: Accommodation Booking : ~100,000 BDT
bullets: University student hostels (OeAD Housing) recommended — book early
Private rental: €400–700/month in Vienna, less in other cities

processSteps.label: Show Fund (Bank Statement) : Min 25 Lac BDT for 6 months
bullets: Austrian authorities require proof of sufficient funds to cover living costs
Bank statement must be recent (within 3 months)

processSteps.label: Austrian Embassy Appointment (New Delhi, India) : Book well in advance

costSteps.label: DHL/FEDEX Courier for Apostille : D=3,250 BDT  |  F=2,650 BDT  (~10,000 BDT total)
